question: Why is geothermal energy referenced in the passage?

options.text: To demonstrate heating and cooling applications

solution: The correct answer is: **Option (2) i.e. To demonstrate heating and cooling applications**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The reference to **“geothermal climate control”** in the passage highlights the use of geothermal energy for heating and cooling buildings and industrial facilities. (ताप और शीतलन अनुप्रयोगों के लिए) • **Example:** Geothermal systems are used in homes and industries for efficient temperature regulation, reducing reliance on conventional energy sources. • The passage lists geothermal energy as one of several industrial applications of renewables, expanding their scope beyond electricity generation. • Thus, geothermal energy is mentioned to illustrate its practical deployment in heating and cooling, not to criticize or focus on cost or politics. Therefore, the correct answer is- To demonstrate heating and cooling applications [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **To criticize its impracticality** (इसकी अव्यावहारिकता की आलोचना करने के लिए): To point out that something cannot be used practically. • **Example:** The passage does not criticize geothermal energy’s practicality. • **To emphasize political impact** (राजनीतिक प्रभाव को उजागर करने के लिए): To focus on how something changes political dynamics. • **Example:** The passage discusses political impact in the context of energy autonomy, not specifically geothermal energy. • **To highlight cost inefficiency** (लागत अक्षमता को उजागर करने के लिए): To show that something is not cost-effective. • **Example:** The passage does not mention geothermal energy as being cost-inefficient. 46:Teb3, The correct answer is **Option 1**.
